verdict.rationale: Delaware Division of Revenue's own pages say its core transactions can be done online: filing through the Delaware Taxpayer Portal, paying by card or bank transfer at tax.delaware.gov, filing and paying withholding tax online, and starting business license registration or renewal through an online account. A probe confirmed the portal is live and that filings sit behind an authenticated session. Missing for 10: no hands-on completion of an end-to-end filing, payment or registration (the probe never interacted past the portal shell), and no evidence that amended-return and Request for Change submissions can be completed online.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: File online using the Delaware Taxpayer Portal. Electronic filing is fast, convenient, accurate and easy.
visit tax.delaware.gov, where you can submit your tax forms and payments electronically using a credit/debit card or bank transfer.
File or pay Withholding Tax online using https://tax.delaware.gov/ or Electronic Funds Transfer.
Create an account with us to begin your business license registration or renew your existing business licenses.
